print_errors.note: The fatha of بها is printed after the alif (it sits over the alif, not over the ha), unlike بِهَا elsewhere on the same page. Kept as printed: بِهاَ.
In prayer ١٠ no comma is printed after مُحَمَّدٍ nor after الجبَّارِ (all other prayers have them), and the jim of الجبَّارِ carries no fatha. Kept as printed.
The quoted ayah أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ… is 27:62 in the standard Kufan count; the book prints ٦١. Kept as printed.
Printed with no space between the colon and the number, unlike every other reference in the batch. Kept as printed.
The red Name مُصَوِّر has its final fatha printed in black (the letters are red). The fatha belongs to the word, so it is kept inside the == markers.

notes: Page 104 ends with a complete sentence (prayer ٦ ends with a period), so p105 starts without '+'; no footnote continues from p104. Page 105 ends in the middle of a Quran quotation (﴿مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ | جَمِيعًا﴾ [فاطر: ١٠]) and page 107 ends mid-sentence (…صُورَةٍ، صَلِّ | وَسَلِّمْ…), so p106 and p108 carry '+'. Because validate.py requires balanced ﴿﴾ on every line, the split quotation is closed with ﴾ at the end of p105 and reopened with ﴿ at the start of p106 (same approach as the poetry-fence rule for page breaks); in the print it is one continuous quotation and the reference [فاطر: ١٠] appears only on p106. Prose عَلَىٰ / إِلَىٰ / حَتَّىٰ / صَلَّىٰ are printed with a dagger alif over the ى and are written with U+0670; on p105 the phrase عَلىٰ نَفْسِي has no fatha on the lam as printed. Words printed only partly vowelled were kept so: سَيِّدِنا, وبَارِكْ, وَمَنامًا, سِواكَ, بقوةٍ, عُبودِيَّتِي, والانكسارِ, وَالاضطرارِ, وخُلُقِي, والأَعْمَالِ, باسْمِكَ, ببشارة, فكانَ, وقَابِلَ, لِلوجودِ, المُؤْمِنِ / المُلْكِ / المَشِيئَةِ etc. (no sukun on the lam of ال where none is printed). Quran passages follow the Tanzil/KFGQPC encoding: dotless ى in فِىٓ, شَىْءٍ, عِبَادِىَ as printed; أُمَّةٍۭ with the small low mim (iqlab) printed under the ة; ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ with the small round zero; ٱلسُّوٓءَ with madda; ذَنۢبِكَ with small high mim; خَلَقَهُۥ and وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ with the small waw/yeh. The stretched وَمَاحِـــيَ on p108 is written without tatweel. Footnote (١) on p108: the volume/page citations are printed as (١٢/ ١٩٥) and (١٢/ ١٠٨) with a space after the slash. No [؟:] markers were needed.
